trailer27b: And here is this room, in full. You are never stuck for an answer at the table: the fact find does the arithmetic, Branch Intelligence reads the file, and the branch team answers your query the same day. And you never start from zero. Clients matched to you, household by household. Leads that land on your own board.

Our new year began in October, and the first class of it is being selected now. Seven places. Not because we can't take more, but because every one gets the full build: a call within forty-eight hours, the Branch Manager himself, and a Discovery with the people already doing it. And one more seat: for a sales manager, to build a unit here. Thirty-two years in Trinidad. One class. Seven places.
